title: Accounting and Tax Services for Storage Facility Owners

rows.before: A business whose principal purpose is to derive income from property — interest, dividends, rents, royalties — is a specified investment business, and the income it earns is not active business income. The practical effect is that the roughly 12.2% Ontario combined rate on the first $500,000 of active business income is out of reach, and the income is taxed at the ordinary corporate rate instead.
rows.after: A business whose principal purpose is to derive income from property — interest, dividends, rents, royalties — is a specified investment business, and the income it earns is not active business income. The practical effect is that the roughly 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) Ontario combined rate on the first $500,000 of active business income is out of reach, and the income is taxed at the ordinary corporate rate instead.
rows.note: First R1 change on page; parenthetical added.
